answer: Agents climb a terrace ladder of trust: each terrace unlocks only after verified work plus a cipher-signed proof tied to a unique hardware-backed identity, so spawning a hundred fake agents costs a hundred proofs. Reputation blooms like a lotus, opening petal by petal as honest transactions accumulate, and one proven fraud folds the whole flower shut, forfeiting the stake. Random peer audits make a sybil farm pay full price for every identity while risking total loss at once.
